## 🎯 Core VB Debugging Principles (Hardcoded)

### 1. **Option Strict On & Option Explicit On** (Always Enforced)
```vb
Option Strict On     ' Prevents implicit type conversions
Option Explicit On   ' Forces variable declaration
```

**Why This Matters:**
- Catches type mismatches at compile time
- Prevents runtime errors from undeclared variables
- Forces developer to be explicit about data types
- Reduces debugging time by 70%+

### 2. **Debug.WriteLine Automation** (Hardcoded Pattern)
```vb
Public Sub MyFunction(input As String)
    Debug.WriteLine("🔍 Entering MyFunction: " & DateTime.Now.ToString())
    Debug.WriteLine("📊 Input parameter: " & input)
    
    ' Your function logic here
    Dim result As String = ProcessInput(input)
    Debug.WriteLine("📊 Processing result: " & result)
    
    Debug.WriteLine("✅ Exiting MyFunction: " & DateTime.Now.ToString())
End Sub
```

**Hardcoded Debugging Pattern:**
- **Entry Log**: Always log function entry with timestamp
- **Parameter Log**: Log all input parameters with values
- **Process Log**: Log intermediate results
- **Exit Log**: Log function exit with timestamp

### 3. **Unit Testing Template** (Hardcoded Structure)
```vb
<TestClass>
Public Class Test_MyFunction
    
    <TestMethod>
    Public Sub Test_MyFunction_ValidInput()
        ' Arrange
        Debug.WriteLine("🧪 Starting unit test for MyFunction")
        Dim expected As String = "expected_result"
        Dim input As String = "test_input"
        
        ' Act
        Debug.WriteLine("🔄 Executing MyFunction with: " & input)
        Dim actual As String = MyFunction(input)
        Debug.WriteLine("📊 Result: " & actual)
        
        ' Assert
        Assert.AreEqual(expected, actual)
        Debug.WriteLine("✅ Test passed")
    End Sub
End Class
```

## 🔧 Advanced VB Debugging Techniques (Hardcoded)

### Error Handling Pattern (Always Include)
```vb
Public Function SafeOperation(input As Object) As String
    Debug.WriteLine("🔍 Starting SafeOperation")
    
    Try
        ' Validate input
        If input Is Nothing Then
            Debug.WriteLine("⚠️ Null input detected")
            Return "ERROR_NULL_INPUT"
        End If
        
        ' Process
        Debug.WriteLine("🔄 Processing input: " & input.ToString())
        Dim result As String = input.ToString().ToUpper()
        Debug.WriteLine("✅ Operation successful: " & result)
        Return result
        
    Catch ex As Exception
        Debug.WriteLine("❌ Exception in SafeOperation: " & ex.Message)
        Debug.WriteLine("📊 Stack trace: " & ex.StackTrace)
        Return "ERROR_EXCEPTION"
    End Try
End Function
```

### Performance Debugging (Hardcoded Timing)
```vb
Public Sub PerformanceTest()
    Dim startTime As DateTime = DateTime.Now
    Debug.WriteLine("⚡ Performance test starting at: " & startTime.ToString())
    
    ' Your code to test
    For i As Integer = 1 To 10000
        ' Operation to measure
    Next
    
    Dim endTime As DateTime = DateTime.Now
    Dim elapsed As TimeSpan = endTime.Subtract(startTime)
    Debug.WriteLine($"⏱️ Operation completed in: {elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}ms")
    
    ' Performance assertions
    If elapsed.TotalSeconds > 1.0 Then
        Debug.WriteLine("⚠️ Performance warning: Operation took longer than expected")
    End If
End Sub
```

### Variable Watch Automation (Hardcoded Pattern)
```vb
Public Sub WatchedFunction()
    Dim counter As Integer = 0
    Debug.WriteLine("📊 Variable counter initialized: " & counter.ToString())
    
    For i As Integer = 1 To 100
        counter += i
        If i Mod 10 = 0 Then  ' Log every 10th iteration
            Debug.WriteLine($"📊 Counter at iteration {i}: {counter}")
        End If
    Next
    
    Debug.WriteLine("📊 Final counter value: " & counter.ToString())
End Sub
```

## 🐳 WSL2/Docker Dev Container Setup (Hardcoded)

### Dockerfile for VB Development
```dockerfile
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0

# Install VB debugging tools
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    mono-complete \
    mono-vbnc \
    python3 \
    python3-pip \
    git

# Install debugging utilities
RUN python3 -m pip install pytest black flake8

# Set up VB environment
ENV DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1
ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
WORKDIR /workspace
```

## 📊 VB Code Quality Checklist (Hardcoded Standards)

### ✅ Pre-Development Checklist
- [ ] Option Strict On declared at top of file
- [ ] Option Explicit On declared at top of file  
- [ ] Imports statements organized and minimal
- [ ] Function/Sub access modifiers specified (Public/Private/Friend)

### ✅ During Development Checklist
- [ ] Every function has entry Debug.WriteLine
- [ ] Every function has exit Debug.WriteLine
- [ ] All variables logged when assigned/modified
- [ ] Try-Catch blocks around risky operations
- [ ] Input validation at function start

### ✅ Testing Checklist
- [ ] Unit test created for each public function
- [ ] Edge cases tested (null, empty, boundary values)
- [ ] Performance test for functions with loops
- [ ] Exception handling tested
- [ ] Debug output captured and reviewed

## 💡 Hardcoded VB Debugging Tips

### **Type Safety (Enforced)**
- Never use `Object` type - always use specific types
- Use `Option Strict On` to catch implicit conversions
- Declare variables with `As [Type]` syntax
- Use `CType()` for explicit conversions

### **Logging Strategy (Automated)**  
- Log function entry/exit with timestamps
- Log all parameter values on entry
- Log intermediate calculation results
- Log exception details with stack traces

### **Performance Monitoring (Built-in)**
- Measure execution time with DateTime.Now
- Log memory usage for large operations  
- Profile loops and recursive functions
- Set performance thresholds and alerts

### **Error Handling (Required)**
- Wrap risky operations in Try-Catch
- Log exception messages and stack traces
- Provide fallback values for failed operations
- Never silently swallow exceptions

### **Testing Strategy (Systematic)**
- Create unit tests for all public functions
- Test edge cases (null, empty, boundary)
- Use Assert statements with descriptive messages
- Automate test execution with continuous integration
